Card Q&A.q: Can I use this card's effect to give this Digimon ?

Card Q&A.a: Digimon retain effects when digivolving or de-digivolving, so  remains.
Card Q&A.q: I use this card to give a Digimon . If that Digimon digivolves into a different Digimon, what happens to ?

Effect: [When Digivolving] Up to 2 of your Digimon gain ＜Retaliation＞ (When this Digimon is deleted after losing a battle, delete the Digimon it was battling) until the end of your opponent's next turn.
